name: Grey Sleeve and Seal (Phất Y Khế Ấn)

bonuses.rule: after you vanish (Gone Before Thanks) or evade an attack, your next sword art within 2 s deals 30 % more damage; if its hit makes the foe Broken, you vanish again. Return to the Scabbard (Quy Sao): after 3 s in which you fire no damaging art, the foe counts as unstruck again, and that counts as a vanish for this bonus.

story: The founder's robe and a sleeve of the dead. The robe passes head to head; the sleeve is chosen from the beams by each new head, and no head says whose. He fights with the Thousand-Cut Sword beside them.

name: Hired Sword's Pair (Dung Kiếm Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Hired Sword's Full Pay (Dung Kiếm Thanh Toán)
bonuses.rule: while you protect a hirer, each crit you land heals you 2 % of your health; if the hirer leaves the fight alive, you are healed in full once.

story: The contract keeper's seal and sword: one signs the hire, the other keeps it. They pass with the post.
